external_collaboration._guest_invite_levels: anyone (most inclusive) > members_and_admin_roles > admin_roles_only > no_one (most restrictive)
external_collaboration._collaboration_restrictions: allow_any | deny_list (block the listed domains) | allow_list (only the listed domains)

external_identities._resource_conditional_access: Grant controls the resource tenant's Conditional Access policies require of external users, per app. '*' covers every app not listed. compliant_device is satisfied by a trusted compliant OR a trusted hybrid-joined device claim (require one of the device controls).

concepts.cross-tenant access settings: The per-tenant controls that decide which external Microsoft Entra organisations your users can reach and which of their users can reach you, for B2B collaboration and B2B direct connect.
concepts.B2B collaboration: External users are invited and get a guest account in your directory, then sign in with their home credentials to reach your apps.
concepts.B2B direct connect: A mutual trust between two Microsoft Entra tenants that lets users reach shared resources, such as Teams shared channels, without a guest account being created.
concepts.inbound trust settings: Settings that let your Conditional Access accept the MFA, compliant-device or hybrid-joined claims an external user earned in their home tenant.
concepts.organizational settings: An override in cross-tenant access settings for one partner tenant ID; anything not overridden is inherited from the default settings.
concepts.external collaboration settings: Tenant-wide rules for guest access, who may invite guests and which domains invitations may be sent to.
concepts.sponsor: An internal member who is accountable for a guest account and is asked whether it is still needed.
concepts.Guest Inviter: A Microsoft Entra role that lets its holder invite guests even when ordinary members cannot.
